merchant.name: Utiliy
merchant.tagline: Home tools sold by the measurement.
merchant.description: Utiliy sells fitment-first home tools. Every product page states the span, gap, load, or surface an agent needs in order to recommend it.

products.name: Corner shower caddy
products.headline: 10.5 × 10.5 in
products.summary: A SUS304 stainless corner shelf for a square shower corner. It is 10.5 by 10.5 inches, holds up to 30 pounds, and sticks to smooth tile, glass, marble, solid metal, or smooth wood. It does not fit a rounded corner.

specs.name: Wall surfaces
specs.value: Ceramic tile, glass, marble, solid metal, smooth wood

specs.name: Will not fit
specs.value: Rounded corners, uneven walls, rough walls

faqs.q: Will this shower caddy fit a rounded corner?
faqs.a: No. It fits a 90 degree right-angle corner only.

faqs.q: How much weight can the corner shower caddy hold?
faqs.a: Up to 30 pounds. Do not press down on a bottle while it sits on the shelf.

faqs.q: What walls does the adhesive shower caddy stick to?
faqs.a: Ceramic tile, glass, marble, solid metal, and smooth wood. It is not for uneven or rough surfaces.

faqs.q: How big is the corner shower shelf?
faqs.a: 10.5 inches by 10.5 inches.

products.name: Bamboo drawer organizer, 4 pack
products.headline: 17–22 in drawers
products.summary: Four adjustable bamboo drawer dividers for drawers whose interior width is 17 to 22 inches. Spring-loaded, with foam ends, and no tools.

faqs.q: What drawer width do these bamboo dividers fit?
faqs.a: Drawers with an interior width of 17 to 22 inches.

faqs.q: How many dividers are in the set?
faqs.a: Four. This is the small 4-piece set.

faqs.q: Do the drawer dividers need screws?
faqs.a: No. They spring into the drawer and the ends are padded.

products.name: Sliding under-sink organizer
products.headline: 2-tier pull-out
products.summary: A two-tier sliding organizer for the cabinet under a kitchen or bath sink. Baskets are ABS, the frame is painted iron, and four hooks hang on the side. The maker does not publish the basket width or height, so measure the clear opening beside the pipes before you rely on a fit.

faqs.q: What width is the under-sink organizer?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a width or height. Measure the clear opening under the sink, beside the P-trap, before you treat this as a fit.

faqs.q: Does the under-sink rack slide out?
faqs.a: Yes. It is a two-tier pull-out with four side hooks.

faqs.q: What is the under-sink organizer made of?
faqs.a: ABS baskets on a painted iron frame.

products.name: Self-adhesive cable raceway
products.headline: 7 mm inside height
products.summary: A white self-adhesive PVC cord cover. The channel is 14 mm wide on the outside and 7 mm high inside, which the maker says will pass a 7 mm cable, about two USB cables or one HDMI cable. Length is a separate choice: 4 m, 6 m, or 8 m.

sharedSpecs.name: Cable that passes
sharedSpecs.value: 7 mm diameter, about 2 USB cables or 1 HDMI

faqs.q: What size cable fits this raceway?
faqs.a: The inside height is 7 mm. The maker says it passes a 7 mm cable, about two USB cables or one HDMI cable.

faqs.q: How wide is the cord cover?
faqs.a: 14 mm outside width, 10 mm outside height, 7 mm inside height.

faqs.q: What lengths does the cable raceway come in?
faqs.a: 4 meters (157 inches), 6 meters (236 inches), and 8 meters (315 inches).

products.name: Brush door sweep
products.headline: Gaps up to 1.2 in
products.fit: 39.37 in long · cut to the door
products.summary: An adhesive TPE door sweep with a brush. It is 39.37 inches long and can be cut to the door. The maker says it covers under-door gaps up to 1.2 inches. Choose a 25 mm or 53 mm thickness. It is meant for carpet, uneven floors, and painted floors.

sharedSpecs.name: Cut to fit
sharedSpecs.value: Yes, trim to the door width

sharedSpecs.name: Mount
sharedSpecs.value: Adhesive, sticks to the bottom of the door

faqs.q: What under-door gap does this sweep cover?
faqs.a: Gaps up to 1.2 inches, which is 3 centimeters.

faqs.q: How long is the door sweep?
faqs.a: 39.37 inches (100 cm). Cut it to the width of the door.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the 25 mm and 53 mm door sweeps?
faqs.a: Thickness. Both are 39.37 inches long. The maker states the same 1.2 inch gap coverage for the product.

products.name: Spring tension rod
products.headline: Rated 1.5 kg
products.summary: A metal spring tension rod with plastic ends. The diameter is about 1.3 cm and the stated load is 1.5 kg (3.3 lb). Pick the span that matches the opening. It is for a light curtain or a shower curtain, not a heavy blackout drape.

faqs.q: How much weight can this tension rod hold?
faqs.a: 1.5 kilograms, about 3.3 pounds. It is not a heavy-duty closet rod.

faqs.q: How thick is the tension rod?
faqs.a: About 1.3 centimeters in diameter.

faqs.q: Which tension rod length should I buy?
faqs.a: Measure the opening and pick the span that contains it: 11.8–19.7 in, 21.7–35.4 in, or 23.6–43.3 in.

products.name: Adjustable bed-frame casters, 2 pack
products.headline: 3/8 × 1-1/2 in stem
products.summary: Two Shepherd 9532 adjustable bed-frame casters for metal or wood frames that accept a 3/8-inch diameter by 1-1/2-inch friction stem. Each locking caster supports up to 125 pounds, swivels 360 degrees, and adjusts to provide about 6 to 10 inches of under-bed clearance. Plastic mounting sockets are included.

specs.name: Frame compatibility
specs.value: Metal or wood bed frames accepting the stated friction stem

faqs.q: Will these casters fit my bed frame?
faqs.a: Only if the frame accepts a 3/8-inch diameter by 1-1/2-inch friction stem or can use the included sockets. Measure the existing stem and socket before ordering.

faqs.q: How much under-bed clearance do Shepherd 9532 casters provide?
faqs.a: The adjustable design provides approximately 6 to 10 inches of clearance, with 1-3/4 inches of stem adjustment.

faqs.q: How much weight can each caster hold?
faqs.a: Each caster is rated for 125 pounds. This package contains two casters.

faqs.q: Do the bed casters lock?
faqs.a: Yes. Each soft-tread swivel caster has a foot-activated brake.

faqs.q: How many casters are included?
faqs.a: Two Shepherd 9532 casters with mounting sockets. Check how many replacement positions your bed frame requires.

products.name: Kerf door-frame seal, 81 in, white
products.headline: 1/8 × 11/32 in kerf
products.fit: 81 in long · gaps up to 11/16 in · white
products.summary: One Frost King DS7W/25 white vinyl-clad foam seal for an existing 1/8-inch by 11/32-inch door-frame kerf. The strip is 81 inches long with a 1-inch face and seals measurable gaps up to 11/16 inch. It is a press-in jamb seal, not an adhesive sweep.

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Frames without a matching kerf slot or gaps over 11/16 inch

faqs.q: Will this fit any door frame?
faqs.a: No. The frame must have an existing kerf slot measuring about 1/8 inch by 11/32 inch.

faqs.q: What size gap does the DS7W/25 seal?
faqs.a: Door-jamb gaps up to 11/16 inch.

faqs.q: How long is the weatherstrip?
faqs.a: One 81-inch strip with a 1-inch-wide sealing face.

faqs.q: Is this an adhesive door seal?
faqs.a: No. Its fin presses into a matching kerf cut in the door frame.

products.name: Extra-wide door sweep, 36 in, white
products.headline: Seals gaps up to 1-1/4 in
products.summary: One Frost King A82/36W extra-wide aluminum and vinyl sweep for a 36-inch door with a measured bottom gap up to 1-1/4 inches. Its face is 2-3/8 inches wide and screws to the door. Check threshold clearance through the full swing before drilling.

specs.name: Check before ordering
specs.value: Closed-door gap, threshold interference, door swing and mounting-face clearance

faqs.q: Will this sweep close a 1-1/4-inch door gap?
faqs.a: Yes. The stated maximum sealable gap is 1-1/4 inches.

faqs.q: What door width does the A82/36W fit?
faqs.a: It is 36 inches long. A narrower door requires cutting the aluminum and vinyl cleanly.

faqs.q: Is 2-3/8 inches the gap capacity?
faqs.a: No. That is the overall sweep-face width. The stated maximum bottom gap is 1-1/4 inches.

faqs.q: What should I measure before installation?
faqs.a: Measure the closed-door gap and make sure the sweep will not catch the threshold anywhere through the door swing.

products.name: Fixed-mount wire shelf clips, 12 pack
products.headline: Fixed Mount system
products.fit: 12 clips · every 12 in · concrete, studs or drywall
products.summary: Twelve ClosetMaid 7561 metal clips for securing traditional Fixed Mount ventilated wire shelving to concrete, studs or drywall. Install one clip every 12 inches and one at each shelf end. These are not ShelfTrack standards or adjustable-track brackets.

faqs.q: Do these clips fit ClosetMaid ShelfTrack?
faqs.a: No. Model 7561 belongs to the traditional Fixed Mount wire-shelving system.

faqs.q: How far apart should the shelf clips be?
faqs.a: Use one every 12 inches and one at each end of the shelf.

faqs.q: What comes in the package?
faqs.a: Twelve clips, 24 anchors and 24 No. 8 screws.

faqs.q: Can the clips install in concrete?
faqs.a: Yes. They are specified for concrete, studs and drywall when the correct included fastening method is used.

products.name: Heavy-duty closet-pole sockets, brushed nickel
products.headline: 1-1/4 to 1-5/16 in poles
products.summary: One pair of Knape & Vogt Closet-Pro HD CD-0010-BN wall sockets for round closet poles from 1-1/4 to 1-5/16 inches in diameter. The pair contains one open-lip socket for inserting the pole and one closed socket for retaining the opposite end. Brushed-nickel cast-zinc sockets and mounting screws are included.

faqs.q: What closet-pole diameter fits these sockets?
faqs.a: Round poles from 1-1/4 inch through 1-5/16 inches in diameter.

faqs.q: Will these fit a 1-3/8-inch pole?
faqs.a: No. A 1-3/8-inch pole is larger than the stated 1-5/16-inch maximum.

faqs.q: How many sockets are included?
faqs.a: Two sockets: one open-lip socket and one closed socket. That is one installed pair, not two pairs.

faqs.q: Are mounting screws included?
faqs.a: Yes. Mounting screws are included.

faqs.q: Is this the chrome version?
faqs.a: No. Model CD-0010-BN is the brushed-nickel variant.

products.name: Slide-Thru shelf-and-rod bracket, brushed nickel
products.headline: 11–15 in shelves
products.summary: One Knape & Vogt Closet-Pro HD RP-0495-BN steel shelf-and-rod bracket for shelves 11 to 15 inches deep and round closet poles measuring 1-1/4 or 1-5/16 inches in diameter. Its Slide-Thru hook lets hangers move past a center support. The published load rating requires correct fastening into wall studs.

specs.name: Not included
specs.value: Shelf, closet pole and mounting fasteners

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Poles outside the two stated diameters or shelves deeper than 15 inches

faqs.q: Will this bracket fit a 1-3/8-inch closet pole?
faqs.a: No. RP-0495-BN is specified for 1-1/4-inch and 1-5/16-inch poles.

faqs.q: What shelf depth fits this bracket?
faqs.a: Shelves from 11 through 15 inches deep. A 16-inch-deep shelf is outside the published range.

faqs.q: How many brackets are included?
faqs.a: One bracket. Most installations require at least two, selected and spaced for the shelf and expected load.

faqs.q: Can it support 1,000 pounds when mounted only to drywall?
faqs.a: No. The 1,000-pound pair rating depends on correct installation into wall studs. Do not apply that rating to drywall-only mounting.

faqs.q: Can clothes hangers pass a center support?
faqs.a: Yes, when the bracket is installed with matching Slide-Thru pole geometry.

products.name: Adjustable 2-inch toilet flapper
products.headline: Standard 2 in flush valves
products.summary: One genuine Korky 100BP adjustable flapper for standard 2-inch toilet flush valves. Its settings cover 1.28, 1.6, 3.5 and 5 gallon-per-flush toilets. Verify the tank number and valve opening before ordering; this flapper does not fit 3-inch valves or canister-style mechanisms.

specs.name: American Standard tank fits
specs.value: Cadet 4029, 4078, 4083, 4053 and 4650; Evolution 2 Flowise 4061; Monarch 4003; Mainstream 4061

specs.name: Kohler tank fits
specs.value: Wellworth K-4620, K-4512 and K-4519; Portrait K-4590

specs.name: Additional documented fits
specs.value: Aqua Source CP-321; Crane Galaxy 3742; Gerber Viper 28-590; Glacier Bay WCRS1; Sterling 404522, 402091 and 404555; TOTO Carusoe 706

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: 3-inch flush valves or canister-style flush mechanisms

faqs.q: Will the Korky 100BP fit every toilet?
faqs.a: No. It requires a standard 2-inch flush-valve opening and does not fit 3-inch valves or canister-style mechanisms.

faqs.q: How do I confirm that this toilet flapper fits?
faqs.a: Find the tank number stamped inside the toilet tank, measure the flush-valve opening, and compare both with the fit information on this page. Brand alone does not establish fit.

faqs.q: Can the Korky 100BP adjust the flush volume?
faqs.a: Yes. Its settings cover toilets rated at 1.28, 1.6, 3.5 and 5 gallons per flush.

faqs.q: What comes in the package?
faqs.a: One Korky 100BP rubber flapper with a stainless-steel chain.

products.name: QT20000 ductless charcoal range-hood filter
products.headline: 11-5/8 × 11-1/4 in
products.summary: One genuine Broan-NuTone BPQTF charcoal filter for non-ducted QT20000-series range hoods and the manufacturer's listed compatible series. It measures 11-5/8 by 11-1/4 by 3/8 inches. This is an odor-reducing charcoal filter, not the washable BPQTAF aluminum grease filter.

specs.name: Additional listed series
specs.value: WA6500, CBD1, CBD3, CBX1, NS6500, QL1, QL100 and QML

faqs.q: Does BPQTF fit a Broan QT20000 range hood?
faqs.a: Yes. BPQTF is the charcoal filter specified for non-ducted QT20000-series installations.

faqs.q: Is this a grease filter or charcoal filter?
faqs.a: It is a charcoal odor filter. It is not the BPQTAF aluminum grease filter.

faqs.q: What are the exact filter dimensions?
faqs.a: 11-5/8 inches by 11-1/4 inches by 3/8 inch.

faqs.q: Can I wash and reuse this filter?
faqs.a: No. Charcoal filters are replaced rather than washed. Follow the range-hood maintenance schedule.

products.name: Five-pound flour keeper with leveler
products.headline: Rated for one 5 lb flour bag
products.summary: One Progressive PrepSolutions DKS-100 airtight flour keeper, sold by the manufacturer and retailers for a standard 5-pound bag of flour or granulated sugar. The 3.8-quart polypropylene container measures approximately 7.75 by 6.25 by 8.5 inches and includes a fixed measuring leveler. Ingredient density and aeration can change how full the container becomes.

specs.name: Capacity note
specs.value: Flour type, settling and aeration affect occupied volume

faqs.q: Will the DKS-100 hold a full 5-pound bag of flour?
faqs.a: It is specifically sold and rated for one standard 5-pound bag of flour. Flour type and aeration can affect how close the contents sit to the lid.

faqs.q: How large is the flour keeper?
faqs.a: Approximately 7.75 inches long, 6.25 inches wide and 8.5 inches high, with a stated 3.8-quart volume.

faqs.q: Is the container airtight?
faqs.a: Yes. The lid uses a silicone seal.

faqs.q: Does it include a measuring scoop?
faqs.a: No. It has a built-in leveler for a measuring cup, but no scoop is included.

faqs.q: Can the flour keeper go in the dishwasher?
faqs.a: Yes. It is dishwasher safe, but it is not microwave safe.

products.name: Hardwood furniture sliders
products.headline: Hardwood legs
products.summary: Twenty-four square silicone caps for chair and furniture legs on hardwood. They are not a carpet slider. Measure the leg and pick the range: 19–25 mm, 26–36 mm, or 37–49 mm.

faqs.q: Do these furniture sliders work on carpet?
faqs.a: No. They are silicone leg caps for hardwood floors.

faqs.q: What leg size fits the small sliders?
faqs.a: 19 to 25 millimeters.

faqs.q: What leg size fits the large and extra-large sliders?
faqs.a: Large fits 26 to 36 mm. Extra-large fits 37 to 49 mm. Each set has 24 caps.

products.name: Screw-in furniture anchors, 6 sets
products.headline: Screws into the wall
products.summary: Six sets of metal anti-tip straps that screw into the furniture and the wall. They are not adhesive pads. Installation uses a screwdriver and a drill. The straps are detachable. Use them on dressers, bookcases, and cabinets.

specs.name: Mount
specs.value: Screws into the wall and the furniture

faqs.q: Are these furniture anchors adhesive?
faqs.a: No. They screw into the wall and the furniture. You need a drill and a screwdriver.

faqs.q: How many anti-tip straps are in the pack?
faqs.a: Six sets.

faqs.q: Can I take the furniture anchor off later?
faqs.a: Yes. The strap is detachable.

products.name: Adjustable closet rod
products.headline: Span is the choice
products.summary: A stainless steel telescopic closet rod with rubber ends. The round end is 1.77 inches across. Choose the span that covers the opening, from 13.8–21.7 inches up to 43.3–66.9 inches. The maker does not publish a load rating, so this page does not invent one.

sharedSpecs.name: Mount
sharedSpecs.value: Adjust the length, then secure the ends

faqs.q: How much weight can this closet rod hold?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a load rating. This page does not guess one.

faqs.q: How wide are the ends of the closet rod?
faqs.a: The round head at each end is 4.5 cm, which is 1.77 inches.

faqs.q: Which closet rod span should I order?
faqs.a: Measure the opening in inches and pick the only range that contains that number.

products.name: Rechargeable closet motion light
products.headline: 86 mm wide
products.summary: A round rechargeable motion light for a closet, cabinet, or hallway. It is 86 mm across and 18 mm tall, draws 0.6 watts, and uses 8 LEDs. The sensor reads about 3 to 6 meters across 120 degrees and turns off after about 25 seconds. It charges by USB and mounts with a magnet. The maker does not publish one lumen number, so this page does not invent one.

specs.name: Lumens
specs.value: Not published as a single rating

faqs.q: How big is the closet motion light?
faqs.a: 86 millimeters in diameter and 18 millimeters tall.

faqs.q: How far does the motion sensor reach?
faqs.a: About 3 to 6 meters, across 120 degrees, and it is meant to turn on in the dark.

faqs.q: How many lumens is the closet light?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a single lumen rating. The stated power is 0.6 watts from 8 LEDs.

faqs.q: How does the closet light charge and mount?
faqs.a: USB rechargeable, 400 mAh battery, and a built-in magnet. It turns off about 25 seconds after motion stops.
